desc:
👋 Welcome to Voxelcraft SMP! Explore, craft, and build your own block-by-block adventure.

🌍 Start a saved Singleplayer world or join friends in Multiplayer. Build a base, farm for food, craft gear, and survive the night.

🔥 Explore the Nether and the End, take on bosses, and unlock achievements along the way. Switch between texture packs in Options to give your world a different look.

⭐ Like and favorite the game, and join our Roblox group to stay up to date!

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang, Microsoft or Minecraft.
